brief:
Zack Polanski has signalled potential changes to the Green Party's grassroots decision-making structures, The Guardian reported. Polanski, writing in the outlet, argued that rapid party growth requires structural reforms that would grant leaders greater control over party operations.

The signal comes after internal conflict over a party vote related to Zionism, which triggered the review of how the organization functions at the grassroots level.

title: Green Party co-leader signals structural overhaul following Zionism vote dispute
